dataPrivacy.dataRightsDesc: Access and deletion controls for your Echo account data.
dataPrivacy.downloadAllDesc: Exports your account, sessions, friends, blocks, and DM metadata as JSON.
dataPrivacy.requestRemovalDesc: Permanently deletes your account and associated personal data.
dataPrivacy.confirmDesc: This permanently deletes your Echo account and personal data. This action cannot be undone.

keybinds.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
keybinds.clickHint: Click a shortcut and press a new key combo to change it.
keybinds.imageViewerDesc: Choose how scroll wheel and trackpad gestures behave while viewing an image.
keybinds.scrollToPanDesc: Two-finger scroll moves the image; pinch to zoom. Turn off to use scroll to zoom instead (classic).
keybinds.scrollToPanAria: Scroll to pan in image viewer
keybinds.needNonModifier: Use at least one non-modifier key.
keybinds.conflict: That shortcut is already assigned to another action.

timeLang.previewDesc: Message timestamps and date labels now follow these preferences across Echo.

plans.lede: Unlock higher quality, bigger uploads, more customization, and premium perks. Pick the plan that fits you.
plans.biggerUploadsDesc: Share files up to 8 GB. No more compressing before sending.
plans.crystalStreamingDesc: Stream at up to 4K {'@'} 60 FPS with studio-grade audio quality.
plans.fullCustomizationDesc: Unlock premium themes, profile effects, and true custom mode on Black.
plans.largerGroupsDesc: Bring up to 250 people into a single group conversation.
plans.earlyAccessDesc: Echo Black members get first look at new features before everyone else.
plans.perksActive: Your subscription perks are active on this account.

advanced.developerDesc: Shows internal IDs and diagnostics on this device only.
advanced.bugHunterDesc: When enabled, Echo records detailed technical activity on this device only (socket traffic, API calls, and where you are in the app). Use the bug report button on the rail to send a report; the last few minutes of traces are included. Turning this off clears the buffer.

dataRights.exportFailed: Could not export your data right now.
dataRights.typeDelete: Type DELETE to confirm permanent removal.

voice.outputIos: On iPhone and iPad Safari, audio playback follows the system speaker. Use Control Center to switch to AirPods or other headphones — Echo cannot pick a separate output device here.
voice.outputMac: In the Mac app, audio playback follows the system default output — Echo cannot apply a separate output device here (this is not a bug with saving).
voice.outputBrowser: This browser uses the system default speaker for playback, so Echo keeps Output Device on the system default.
voice.micPlayback: Your voice is played through the selected Output Device (use headphones to avoid feedback).
voice.manualGainActive: Manual gain control is active (AGC is off).
voice.maxBoostWarningTitle: Warning: Max Boost Can Cause Damage
voice.maxBoostWarning1: Max Boost can produce dangerously loud audio levels. This may lead to hearing damage and/or speaker damage. It is not recommended.
voice.maxBoostWarning2: By continuing, you acknowledge the risk and agree that Echo takes no liability for any resulting damage or injury.

a11y.highContrastDesc: Increase contrast in text, borders, and key actions.
a11y.dyslexiaDesc: Swap the main UI font for Atkinson Hyperlegible, a more readable alternative.
a11y.messageSpacingDesc: Add extra vertical breathing room between messages for easier scanning.
a11y.solidGlassDesc: Replace blurred glass panels with solid backgrounds for clearer text on browsers where backdrop blur fails or washes out.
a11y.reducedMotionDesc: Tone down transitions, blur shifts, and UI animations.

friends.disabledNote: When disabled, others cannot start that kind of request toward you.
friends.friendRequestsDesc: Let people send you requests to become friends.
friends.messageRequestsDesc: Let people who are not friends open a DM or request to message you.
friends.showLastOnlineDesc: Let friends and server members see when you were last online.
friends.intro: Manage whether people can reach out to you directly. Sound behavior lives in {sounds}, and desktop alerts live in {notifications}.

sounds.globalDesc: Set the overall sound state and master level for this device before fine-tuning individual events.
sounds.globalHint: Control the master state first, then use it as the baseline for each event below.
sounds.allSoundsDesc: Master switch for every event sound below.
sounds.masterLevelDesc: Scales every enabled sound before per-event volume.
sounds.eventsDesc: Enable or mute specific sounds, preview them, and open event volume only when you need extra control.
sounds.eventsHint: Use the checkbox to enable each sound, preview it, and open volume when you need finer control.

appearance.railDesc: On phones, navigation uses a bottom tab bar. Tablet layouts (600px and up) keep the side rail with a split channel view.
appearance.vibrant: Stronger accent, mention, and ping colors across the app.
appearance.serversAlwaysOnDesc: Keep server icons visible when DMs or Explore are open.
appearance.extendedListDesc: Show up to 10 servers on the side rail instead of 5.

notif.turnOnToTest: Turn on "Desktop notifications" above to test.
notif.uploadLimits: Max {mb}MB per file. Free: 1 custom ringtone, Echo+: 16, Echo Black: 256.
notif.intro: Personal notification defaults that sync across your devices. They combine with per-server settings (server menu → Notification Settings).
notif.soundsMovedDesc: Use the Sounds tab for per-sound toggles, volume, and preview.
notif.badgesDesc: Show {'@'} / − on server icons when a non-default level is set.
notif.readFail: Could not read that audio file. Try another format.
notif.iosHome: On iPhone and iPad, Safari web notifications only work after adding Echo to the Home Screen.
notif.unsupported: Desktop notifications are not supported in this environment.
notif.testAlert: This is a test alert. Personal settings sync across your devices.
notif.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
notif.desktopNotificationsDesc: Allow the browser to show system notifications.
notif.highlightsDesc: Control how mention rows are highlighted in chat.
notif.highlightAllOn: Highlights direct, role, and broadcast mentions.
notif.ringtonesDesc: Choose your default call ringtone and manage custom uploads.
notif.controlsBadgesDesc: Controls badges on the server rail and system-style alerts.

profile.bannerEffectsDesc: Blur and blackout match the channel header look for servers. You can combine them with refraction.
profile.resetDesc: This will discard all unsaved changes and restore your last saved profile state.

account.accountSecurityDesc: Manage your sign-in credentials and security settings.
account.noPhone: No phone on file. Unlock account to add one.
account.phoneSaveHint: Save changes to update your number, then request an SMS code.
account.passwordRequiredDesc: Please enter your password to edit sensitive account information.
account.changePasswordDesc: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
account.scanQr: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then continue.
account.enter6: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
account.recoveryDesc: Each code works once if you lose your device. Store them somewhere safe — they won’t be shown again.
account.requires2fa: Your account now requires 2FA for sign-in.
account.tfaManageLater: You can manage 2FA from this section in the future.
account.disableTfaDesc: Enter your password and a valid authenticator code or recovery code.
account.disableAccountDesc: This will temporarily disable your account. You can re-enable it later.
account.signOutAllDesc: This signs you out on every device and revokes all active sessions. You can sign in again anytime.
account.deleteAccountDesc: This will permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
account.leaveBlank: Leave blank if you sign in with Discord or as a guest.
account.resetAccountDesc: This will discard all unsaved changes to your email and phone number.
account.tfaRequireDesc: Require an authenticator code when you sign in.
account.tfaProtectDesc: Protect your account with an extra layer of security.
account.passkeysDesc: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, or Windows Hello. You can add several passkeys and remove ones you no longer use.
account.passkeyPrompt: Follow your browser or device prompt to create a passkey…
account.removalMock: Need to leave? You can temporarily disable your account or permanently delete it.
account.removalReal: Sign out on all devices, or permanently delete your Echo account and data.
account.sessionsGuest: Session management is available after you upgrade to a full account.
